objects.st: Only when it says The End is when you know it is The End...
Everything is not what it seems...

This room is happiness.
I am not insane.
Stay in chair.
Repeat.
Thank you for completing your procedural sleep therapy! Please take the red door to wake up.
Ok you must be colorblind. Please take the door on your left with the LARGE arrows.
Oh god give me a break, let me make this very simple for your peanut sized brain, please take the door IN FRONT of you to wake up.
When you wake up please rate us with a 5 star review! Goodbye!
